services.title: Auto repair
services.body: Vehicles are diagnosed and repaired at the actual fault before anything gets replaced.

reviews.author: Marjorie Shingle
reviews.text: My check engine light came on while visiting from Pennsylvania. Stan got me in same day, ran a diagnostic and called me with options. I opted to do all new spark plugs and ignition coils. It was done the same day at a reasonable price! Thank You again!

reviews.author: tony Mitchell
reviews.text: These guys are absolutely amazing very helpful, professional 10 stars. I was having an issue with my car they go on it right then very nice crew. Any time I'm in myrtle beach area and I have any trouble this is where I will come to. I definitely refer anyone who needs work done to see these guys.

reviews.author: Brad Sanford
reviews.text: Took my truck there to get aligned. They called and said they don’t have a special tool to do it. I pick it up and they made me pay $94 before I could get keys even though they couldn’t do the job. I asked how they justified that and they said they got it close. I said it’s not aligned if close. I drove down the street and it’s the exact same pull to the right. Blamed it on my tires but my tires are brand new. My old tires pulled too. That’s why I had it aligned. I had other jobs I wanted done but it won’t be there. $94 cost them plenty of work and a bad reputation Don’t bother taking a car there. I should’ve known when he started off as a smart mouth when I first walked in

reviews.author: Amanda Davis
reviews.text: Should be 50 stars!!!! We had recently taken my car to the Ford dealership at home to see what the popping noise was coming from the front of my car. Ford wanted $4,0000 to replace shocks and a list of other things. While on vacation we noticed it was getting worse. We stopped by beach boys and they were so friendly, informative, took their time to really check my car over. I desperately needed tires, and they found me a great set for less than what I was quoted before at home . They changed my oil. My oil is hard to find but they got it here! Ended up being the motor mount that was causing the noise. Needless to say, I got all my needs met with my car for more than half less than what Ford was saying and what Ford was saying wasn’t even what was wrong with it!!!! Thank yall so much for being honest and so very nice and compassionate. God led us to yall boys and we r grateful to him and yall!!! We now have a vacation mechanic shop if we ever need one again. I will go no where else!!! Thank yall and God bless yall more than yall can stand, Jason and Amanda Davis.

reviews.author: todd hoiland
reviews.text: I cannot recommend these guys enough. I’ve taken my truck there a few times and the end result is always amazing. You need a quality mechanic? Go talk to Stan.

reviews.author: Kay Hochschild
reviews.text: Pros: appointments can be scheduled, coffee while you wait Cons: poor communication, wait period for parts of a few days, a menu of charges for every little thing and poor customer service. Waited quite awhile to post this review because I wasn’t in the mood for the manager’s response I’ll probably receive. I was new to the area and very unfamiliar with auto repair shops, however needed my car serviced and ended up at Beach Boya Automotive. To this day I’m not sure what happened but the service appointment blew up in smoke. I apologize for my part in asking questions about price breakdown. I needed to get the lock mechanism repaired and after removing the side panel from my car it was determined that the part needed would not be in for a few days which was fine, however they were going to charge me around $75 to put the door panel on for me to leave which I had never experienced before and a quote had been provided that included labor to remove the door panel and put it back on when I did the repair after the part came in. I left driving without a door panel and the window was broken in heavy rain. I asked if they could help me put my license plate on my car and charged me $25 which I didn’t expect. The person I was dealing with became extremely irate and scared me. I ended up going down the street and found out that I did not need the part they said I needed and they showed me on Amazon the $19 part needed to do the repair myself. They put the door panel on for me.

reviews.author: Karen Silva
reviews.text: I had new tires put on my car and had a problem with my rear seat disengaging. Ethan and Stan kept me informed, the work was done in a timely manner and the price was reasonable. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Matt Burton
reviews.text: I was out of town on vacation and these guys made me feel like I was dealing with my own mechanic from home. Highly recommend them got me in and out on the same day. I will always pass their name on.

reviews.author: Kylie Price
reviews.text: Beach boys are very honest, knowledgeable, and reliable people. You can tell that they really want to do right by the customer. I won’t take my car anywhere else.

reviews.author: jeffrey bennett
reviews.text: I would highly recommend Beach Boyz Auto Repair. While down on vacation I had some car troubles. Stan and his staff treated me like I was one of there regular customers from the moment I walked in the door. They gave me a ride back to my resort and started working on my car shortly after. By the end of the day my car was fixed and I was on my way. Thank You !!

reviews.author: Alyson McGugan
reviews.text: My mom’s tire light came on the day she was leaving to drive 2 hours back home by herself. I stopped in and was immediately greeted by a pleasant gentleman who took her car right in, checked out the tires, found the issue, fixed the tire and sent me on my way very quickly. It’s hard to find great customer service like these guys provided to me today. It was very much appreciated! Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Kristine Genova
reviews.text: Truly the best of the best!! They took care of us when we were stuck between a rock and a hard place. They communicated with us through out the day with any updates that they had. They are honest, upfront and welcoming! We will be back for any of our vehicle needs!!

reviews.author: Tom Martin
reviews.text: Called on a Friday to get in for front rotors and pads before we left to go on a 10 hour ride home,Stan got us in the schedule,advised that the rear would need attended to in the near future. They replaced front and in and out in a couple hours. I can’t thank Stan and his crew enough!

reviews.author: Elijah May
reviews.text: Fantastic service! Ran into vehicle problems the day before we were supposed to travel back home from vacation. They squeezed us in on short notice and did a GREAT job.

reviews.author: Rachel McDowell
reviews.text: 10 out of 10 stars. Amazing group of guys that work there. My brakes went bad and they had me in and out in hours, same day. I will tell everyone about this place. We are lucky to have this standup and honest business to go to in this area. Grateful for y’all keeping me and my daughters safe out on the road.

reviews.author: Michael Cheek
reviews.text: The folks here were just outstanding. A great, organized, and professional crew that I would recommend to anyone. Was about to leave from a Family vacation and they were able to assess quickly that I needed a new radiator and several hoses. They chased parts across town and done a 6 hour plus job to get me on the road that same evening. Even though this was expensive work, their price and labor charge was as fair as I have seen anywhere. Big Thanks to you all !

reviews.author: Andrew Brock
reviews.text: These guys are awesome. The last 2 hours of our drive in for a week long vacation the AC goes out in the car. Since it was Sunday there wasn't much we could do about it. Called around on Monday and Stan and his team got us in right away. They had us all fixed up by that afternoon. He even insisted I come back on Friday before we leave so his guys could make sure nothing was leaking and we were good for our trip home. Outstanding service and very professional. They are a fair and honest group.

reviews.author: J Ramos
reviews.text: I have to say what a professional, respectful, personable bunch of guys. Here on Vacation had some noise issue from our front end that I was worried about as soon as we arrived here. I brought it to the Beach Boyz and met Stan. Told him my concern since we drove so far and wanted to make sure that my vehicle was safe to drive back for the safety of my family. It’s a little worrisome not being from here finding a mechanic shop you can trust. They test drove it understood what my concern was then they checked it out. They showed me what they saw and I tell you I trust these group of guys! I want to Thank You Stan, and your guys for taking your time when I know you probably had other vehicles to take care but you fit us in. Thank You and May the Lord Bless you and your shop!! Very Grateful!

reviews.author: Tommy Little
reviews.text: My wife and I have used Beach Boyz several times and we could not be happier! Everyone at the shop is professional and quick to greet you. They have always done what they said they would do and their prices are very reasonable. I would highly recommend them to anyone! Great job by everyone at the shop!

reviews.author: Colton Jimenez
reviews.text: Phenomenal service. Prior aircraft mechanic and do not trust many shops with my vehicle. I usually do all maintenance but was here on vacation and took my truck in for an oil change and chassis lube. They did a thorough inspection as well and from the phone call I could tell they knew what they were doing. Would highly recommend! Everything about it was 5-star.

reviews.author: CJ Robinett
reviews.text: I would recommend Beach Boyz to all! Great customer service, fair pricing and they really came through when I needed them! My clutch went out and needed it fixed quickly. They were able to have it completed within a day! Very impressed and thankful to find a loyal great company! I will definitely be using them from here on out! Thank you to Stan and your team!

reviews.author: Shelli Stesiak
reviews.text: Amazing experience with this repair shop! Price was decent , truck fixed in 2 days! Owner is awesome! Highly recommend BeachBoyz Auto Repair!

reviews.author: Sarah Barker
reviews.text: I cannot say enough good things about Stan and his crew. An auto problem is the last thing you want to deal with on vacation, but Stan's professionalism and knowledge put us at ease. When our warning light came on, we stopped at an auto store for a quick diagnostic. The first recommendation for repair was Beach Boyz....and we're so thankful for that. Stan had us safely back on the road before we headed home. I hope I don't ever "have" to stop in there, but if a problem occurs, he'll be my first choice!

reviews.author: Jim Carlson
reviews.text: Another round of applause for Stan and his guys at Beach Boyz Automotive Repair. I recently needed new rear brake pads & rotors, rear brake lines, master cylinder, vacuum booster, and water pump. That's a lot of work. His guys stayed two hours AFTER closing and one hour BEFORE opening to get the job done. A day later the master cylinder failed again. They took it back, ordered a newer, upgraded one from a different supplier at no extra cost to me. All is good with the vehicle now. This morning, I delivered a dozen doughnuts and some Munchkins to show my appreciation for going above and beyond by putting in the early & late hours to get me operational again as quickly as possible and for making it right when things went wrong. Stan is the man!!

reviews.author: Patrick Walsh
reviews.text: Very knowledgeable of many makes and models. Great communication and service. I highly recommend Beach Boyz.

reviews.author: Richard DeMarchi
reviews.text: My dealership said I needed brakes. But I didn’t think so. Almost a year later I took my car to Beach Boys telling them my dealer told me I needed brakes and rotors. After they inspected the brakes, they said I had at least 10,000 miles left. In fact, have less wear on them than what my dealer. TRUST these Beach Boyz, they can’t sing, but they are truly HONEST!

reviews.author: Thomas Brendel
reviews.text: This is definitely going to be my new Go-To auto mechanic. Only been a couple times for minor issues (headlight replacement and oil change) but these folks are extremely personable and trusting. Both workmanship and pricing are second to none. The cost of the headlight was actually less expensive than the quote given to me...you cannot beat that for honestly and integrity! Thank Beach Boyz!

reviews.author: Janet Passino
reviews.text: My son traveled from NY to Myrtlebeach to visit me. He had trouble with the car brakes on his way down. This shop worked him in their busy schedule to accommodate him because he was there on vacation. Rear brakes needed replacing and the owners could not have been nicer. The owner actually came out to meet us and explain what was done and also advised my son of another potential problem he should have ckd out when he returned home. He assured us the car was safe to drive the 800 miles home. I highly recommend them for servicing your vehicles.

reviews.author: Parker
reviews.text: Highly recommend! Very honest and great customer service! I took my suburban in for new breaks and rotors and they got me right in and out which was wonderful bc I was here for vacation and the started acting up on our way day!

reviews.author: Buffalo Combat Fitness Joe Indelicato
reviews.text: We were from Buffalo, NY and have a condo in Surfside. Stan fixed our minivan in hours when we were in a bind. He gave a us a ride to and from. The work and price were very good also. We highly recommend them and will be back!

reviews.author: Joe G
reviews.text: Stan and the guys at Beach Boyz are great. Very honest with their work, prices, and always willing to help you out. Does not matter if it is a classic car or a new one, they'll take care of you. Glad to have found this shop!

reviews.author: Russell Lark
reviews.text: My dad took his vehicle here to have a wheel bearing replaced. Randy took the vehicle for a drive so he could verify what we were noticing. Before replacing the wheel bearing, they rotated the tires to make sure it wasn’t a tire making the roaring noise that we were hearing, which could have been a much cheaper/more simple repair. It ended up being a wheel bearing, and they replaced it at fair/reasonable price. They were very friendly and helpful along the way. Kudos to Randy and Stan for a job well done.

reviews.author: Bruce Seiden
reviews.text: When we drove from Asheville to Mrytle Beach on Sunday, the water pump started making noise and the pulley was vibrating badly. I saw their great reviews and gave them a call. They we able to sneak me into a busy day and replaced the water pump and belt. They called with a price for pre-approval and had the car fixed by the end of the day. Very fair price and great service! Another benefit was the enterprise rental car office across the street so we were able to get a car and enjoy the day. I would recommend Beach Boyz Auto Repair to anyone needing service.

reviews.author: Jeff Rook
reviews.text: Really good service and very fair priced. Will definitely go here again next time I need something done. We took one of our cars in for a coolant leak that turned out to be a hole in the radiator that is a long process on a vw so I thought we’d be leaving it overnight but a few hours later they called and said it was ready. They worked me in on what seemed to be a busy day so I’m very grateful for that and I really felt like they went above and beyond what some of my other experiences have been like at other places. Thank you Stan and the rest of the crew, we will be back to you guys but hopefully not too soon.

reviews.author: Nicole Bizzoco
reviews.text: 10/10 highly recommend. We will never go to another mechanic again. We brought one truck to fix the ac and the next day as we picked it up we dropped off a car to fix the ac. Our truck has not ran with ac that makes us cold in a long time! These guys are quick and reasonably priced. Thank you Shane and Evan!

reviews.author: Mary Jo Pleune
reviews.text: Highly recommend them. I'm a widow and winter in Surfside. I will drop in when I have an issue with my Jeep. They always fit me in, take time to explain the problem and have given me excellent service at a fair price. A++ service.

reviews.author: Daniel Gordon
reviews.text: While visiting from Central Illinois my truck wouldn't start one evening. I had to leave it at a restaurant overnight and get it towed to a local shop. No one had time to take a look at my truck but one of the shops said to try Stan at Beach Boyz. Stan was more than courteous and professional. I thought I was going to be in for about $1,000 with a new starter but these guys went through my Nisan Titan and found a loose wire. The charge was minimal to what it could have been. These guys are saints. He left me with great news, a smile and a hand shake. I couldn't recommend my own home town mechanic as much as I would recommend these guys.

reviews.author: Laurie Luckmann
reviews.text: We had car trouble on vacation and brought our car here. Stan is knowledgeable and professional. He spent a lot of time troubleshooting a weird issue with my car. I highly recommend this place!

reviews.author: Guy Stewart
reviews.text: They was charging me for one job then randomly said they had to take extra money to put a serpentine belt. But you have to take the belt off anyways to get the alternator. They tried to play me like I was goofy saying it's two different jobs. Any one can look up they got to take the belt off to get to the alternator. He though I was just gonna keep giving more and more than what he originally told me. Scam at its finest. He was screaming and irate as I pointed that out.

reviews.author: DEBRA SCOTT
reviews.text: While visiting the beach I got a nail in my tire. Two other places refused to try to plug it. Beach Boyz did and did a wonderful job!! I made it home to WV with no trouble. They were friendly and concerned about me and my 92 yr old mom heading back. But we did and my tire is perfectly fine!!! Appreciate you Beach Boyz

reviews.author: talisa edmundson
reviews.text: BEACH BOYZ was amazing!! We were recommended by family to go here and I'm so glad we did. We came in from out of state and hit something causing some issues in our car. They were able to get it taken care of so quickly we didnt even have to change any of our holiday plans. The prices were great and the customer service was even better. Would definitely recommend them to anyone who needs repairs.

reviews.author: Mr. R
reviews.text: Fantastic service! Fair prices! High-quality results! Stan performed a quick-fix on my air conditioning to get me back home from the beach. His fix lasted the entire 8 hours it took for me to travel home from vacation, and protected me and my family from 100 degree heat mixed with torrential rain. Not bad for a guy from Texas, New Jersey - great guy. Wonderful with his customers! If you need your car fixed, go to Stan-the-Man @ Beach Boys Auto Repair.

reviews.author: Michael Gonshor
reviews.text: I would highly recommend this auto repair shop. I brought my daughter's SUV in after hearing a grinding noise in the front end. Stan and his team of skilled mechanics quickly diagnosed the problem, clearly described the repair that needed to be done and detailed why. The work was done in the time they said and at the quoted estimate. The folks at Beach Boyz are very knowledgeable, professional and provide outstanding customer service at very fair prices. On a side note, I returned several days later to their extremely busy shop with an unrelated issue. They repaired a loose exhaust hanger in a matter of minutes. The cost? Well, I was told to have a good day. Beach Boyz Auto Repair is definitely my "Go to" shop. Thank you again Stan.

reviews.author: Scott Bell
reviews.text: While visiting Garden City from Ohio, I developed a problem with my Jeep thermostat. With only a couple days before our scheduled 12 hour drive back home I needed help. Stan not only squeezed me into his busy schedule but he diagnosed and fixed my issue. His prices were fair, his staff was awesome and his personal customer service was outstanding. Highly recommend his shop. Hopefully I won't need him on my next visit but it is nice to have someone like him if needed!

reviews.author: Fran Damato
reviews.text: Fast, friendly and professional. I needed to get a new alternator for my Honda. Randy was honest and kind from beginning to end. I was impressed with how fast and efficient the service was. He had the part delivered within minutes and managed to change it right in front of me. The other guys were very friendly throughout my short visit as well! The service was always about the guest and you can tell they really care about their job! On top of the quality service, their prices are very reasonable, too. I absolutely recommend this company!

reviews.author: Lucas VanAusdoll
reviews.text: On vacation and my exhaust was extremely loud. I called several shops and most was rude. This was the only shop that was inviting! They got my truck right in and said unfortunately it would be the next day for the part! Well Stan called later in the day and he found the part and got me going! The customer service and price was amazing! I would highly recommend this shop! It’s always worrisome to be out of town with a mechanical issue! Not these guys! Great Job!

reviews.author: Marybeth Collins
reviews.text: Rolled into Beach Boyz concerned about my tire sensor and road noise seeming louder than normal. The gentleman listened, checked my air pressure, triggered off the sensor and took me for a spin to evaluate the noise issue because he could see I was worried..He didn’t accept payment, gave me exceptional advice, and sent a (much relieved) me on my way. I lived about 30 miles away and would gladly have traveled to make this my maintenance go-to. I highly recommend this business and understand why his customer satisfaction ratings are so high. Trust me-and trust him.

reviews.author: Shana Morris
reviews.text: Impeccable service and very fair, reasonable pricing. My communication was only with the two owners and they are both so kind and helpful. I had already gotten one estimate from another shop and they came in at almost $40 cheaper! They not only fixed my car and had it ready the same day but the owner himself gave me a ride home while I waited and then picked me up when my car was ready. I highly recommend getting your car fixed here! I will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Dick Nese
reviews.text: lived here 2 years and always worried about a repair service that would eventually need. Well the time came and I went to Stan at Beach Boyz. had a nightmare brake problem. He took care of it. I know allot about cars but I let him explain as I do with every new mechanic. he insisted I understand the process. I do this so I have no fear of referring family and friends in the future. His service and crew are great. If you live here feel secure in being treated fairly and confident you are being treated honestly. If you visit the area and have an unforeseen or unexpected emergency, Im sure they will treat you as well as they treated me. Ill be a regular

reviews.author: John Miller
reviews.text: Took my 2011 Silverado to them today with 3 problems.. They quickly diagnosed the problem and fixed all 3. Price was very reasonable considering what they had to do. I do a lot of my own work on cars, so I understand what it takes. I met Stan, the owner, he's the best. Will be a repeat customer, but hopefully, not soon :)

reviews.author: Tom Ellis
reviews.text: Owner Stan Kaplan took me back to condo so I would not have to wait at his shop while he worked on my auto. Once repair work completed he picked me up. He did a execellant job in repairing my vehicle.Very professional and completely trustworthy! Tom Ellis

reviews.author: Nancy Armstrong
reviews.text: Being an older woman it is difficult to find a mechanic that you can trust. The people at Beach Boyz are wonderful. They identify the problems quickly and they repair them at a very reasonable price. An oil change here is half of what you pay up north. If you're down here on vacation I would highly recommend you get any work done here! Randy is very polite and professional and makes everything easy to understand. I can't say enough good things about the staff. They were all very nice and very helpful.

reviews.author: Bug Busters Pest Control
reviews.text: Awesome place and people! They take care of my work vehicles and personal cars from oil changes to everything else that goes wrong. They’re honest, helpful and their pricing is great.

reviews.author: Cayce Rose
reviews.text: I was on vacation in the area and my car began smelling like gas and having trouble starting. I took my car to this place in the morning without an appointment and explained that I would be leaving in two days. Stan, the owner, was so helpful and understanding and started checking it out immediately. He showed me where the problem was and explained exactly how they would have to fix it, and he made sure I understood everything without ever talking down to me. He got my car back to me even sooner than he said, and it was completely fixed. Stan also said to contact him if the car had a similar issue again and he would find a place near me that would warranty it. This was the best and most honest experience I’ve ever had at an auto shop. I wish I knew a place like this back home. Thank you!!

reviews.author: James Moss
reviews.text: These guys are AWESOME!! Great prices, EXCELLENT customer service, and very professional!! I called Randy at 8 AM, he didn't have my tire size there, but said he would order it and have it there by 1 and on my truck by 5. He did it before 4!!! These guys are AMAZING!! If you have any car trouble at all, I HIGHLY recommend these guys, best customer service in town!!

reviews.author: Sam Dickson
reviews.text: We were down here from NY and our car started stalling. I called Stan and even with a busy as they were with his normal local business, he found a way to squeeze me in and had my car fixed the next day. I cannot say enough about the integrity, class, and professionalism that Stan has. He saved our vacation and Ihighly recommend his service as it is as good as it comes. Thank you for everything again Stan!

reviews.author: Marlene Kanipe
reviews.text: Great service at a fair price. Fixed my AC up right so I can get safely home to Ohio. Highly recommend if you are in the area with car troubles. Responsive and great accurate diagnostic trouble shooting.

reviews.author: Wes Lang
reviews.text: I have taken my car twice to them for brake issues. They have a great manager and service team who I feel like had my best interest in mind both times and I have walked away feeling like I was taken care of and a valued customer. I will continue to take my vehicle to Beach Boyz. Bottom line is they have excellent service, customer care, and prices. I would recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: Anthony Tortorici
reviews.text: Beach Boyz Auto is top notch! Stan and his wife run an honest, fair and reasonably priced shop. Stan has worked on my Toyota Tacoma and Chevy Tahoe. Stan replaced my brake system on my Tacoma and Chevy Tahoe. I had a minor annoying squeak in the brakes after some time on the Tacoma. I returned it to Stan, and he corrected the issue immediately! Stan will stand behind his work and will make sure the repairs are done right. The mechanics here are top notch! Stan and his Wife treat you like family, and always want to make sure you are a happy customer. I highly recommend them, as they will treat you right!

reviews.author: Tyler Mills
reviews.text: We were on vacation in the area and had some complications with a vehicle. The guys at Beach Boys were beyond welcoming and helped us get some wiring that we could not find at any local parts store. They gave us what we needed so that I could fix the issue to get us home. Without them we would have been stuck here with a ton on money spent to get us home. Thanks so much guys!

reviews.author: Timothy White
reviews.text: Came in this morning with the dreaded check engine light on with the advice of a friend. The guys gave me a very accurate time frame and got the issue diagnosed and repaired very quickly. When I went to pick it up the estimate was spot and they even pulled my vehicle to front and turned the AC on. Will go back for maintenance and any other issues that might arise with my elderly vehicle. Highly highly recommend.

reviews.author: Allen Moore
reviews.text: Very customer friendly. Analylized a transmission problem for me. Did not try to sell me services I did not need. Would recommend.

reviews.author: Randy Jackson
reviews.text: Had brake issues with my Toyota 4 Runner while on vacation at Surfside beach. Called Stan and he was able to squeeze me in on short notice and got me back on road for trip home safely. Stan was very personable and professional and kept in touch with me throughout about what was needed,cost,time,etc. He and his staff went the extra mile when an unexpected repair was required. He may remember the "4runner from hell" but I will give Beach Boyz my best recommendation and when I retire soon to the sand they will be my "boyz".

reviews.author: Jakob Matics
reviews.text: Great experience at Beach Boyz. Incredibly knowledgeable and professional, transparent throughout the entire process. Explained everything clearly and confirmed before the work was done. Will definitely be coming back for any future needs. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jamie Young
reviews.text: Beach Boyz completely took care of us. We were in town for vacation when my daughters car had a mechanical issue. Evan worked our car in knowing we would be leaving in a few days. Not only was the car fixed quickly, it was done at a very fair price and done without a bunch of “extras”. They only fixed what was absolutely necessary and then informed us of what may be needed in the future. I cannot give enough stars to this business. Stan and Nancy, you guys need to take more days off knowing your business is in good hands with Evan. Thanks again!

reviews.author: Melissa Keene
reviews.text: At the beginning of the dreadful COVID my AC went out. Almost everyone was on quarantine...unable to work. I called Randy at Beach Boyz and thankfully he was still open for business but working alone. He repaired my AC which was a big job... had to remove the dashboard etc. He was working by himself so it took a little longer than expected. He was very apologetic and gave me a really nice discount!! Just the other day I had a problem with my gear shift. Dropped my car off and it was repaired and ready the same day!! Randy is the best as I’m sure everyone else there is. Awesome customer service, friendly and so efficient with very reasonable pricing!! Thank you Beach Boyz!!

reviews.author: Troy Walker
reviews.text: Stan and Nancy are 2 very sweet folks. We were out of town for a few days and my power windows decided to not work anymore. I tried at least 3 auto zones and 2 nissan dealers and all were either too busy or could not get the part needed. Stan called me within an hour after I dropped my vehicle off, explained what the problem was and had it repaired by 2pm that afternoon. He picked me up from my hotel and brought me back to my car and made an otherwise difficult trip alot easier. Nancy was the final touch before heading home with her smile and charm. We definitely will be using this repair shop going forward if necessary for any other auto repairs! Great job guys! Keep up the great customer service!

reviews.author: Elaine Merkus
reviews.text: Here on vacation and had problems with our truck brakes. Called first thing in the morning and Stan encouraged us to come right away. He diagnosed got the part and brought us to the beach while they fixed it. Amazing service! Thanks so much!!

reviews.author: Amber Silva
reviews.text: This is the ONLY auto shop I trust!!!! The mechanics are polite, professional, and honest. I refer all my friends & even strangers here. One friend had his dealership charge him over $700 for a new part. He came to Beach Boyz for a second opinion & it was $200 repair. They explained explained everything they needed to do & he's still driving this vehicle with over 200000 miles on it. Check them out!! They may be busy but its always worth the wait

reviews.author: Vanessa Tabit
reviews.text: I have taken two of our cars to Beach Boyz Auto Repair since recently moving to Surfside Beach, The low tire pressure light came on in my vehicle. After I was unsuccessful trying to put air in the tire at a gas station, I drove over to Beach Boyz Auto Repair. The technician, Kirby, identified the culprit (a gigantic staple of some sort) and fixed my tire right then and there. About a week later, one of the headlights on my son’s vehicle stopped working. We took the car to Beach Boyz. They diagnosed the problem and fixed it the same day. This family owned business has a skilled team that provide prompt friendly service. I appreciate their professionalism and dedication to quality repairs. Beach Boyz Auto Repair is the only place to go for automotive repairs!

reviews.author: Mary Eaton
reviews.text: We had 2 cars with check engine lights come on and took one here and the other towed here on the same day. What are the odds of that happening? We were greeted respectively and told they would get one car up and running as soon as they could. We suspected the towed car was done for and sorrowfully it is but the owner is trying to help us dispose of it. The other car is running now so we are not car less any more. I would take my business to Beach Boyz again in a minute. They have been here less than a year but have 30 years experience in NJ if I heard correctly. I appreciate their service very much and recommend them.

reviews.author: Missy Grimm
reviews.text: Best place! Called about having a tire checked for a leak and they gave me a time to bring it in so I wouldn't have to wait too long. A quick 15 minutes later, I was on my way with a plug in my tire and back to the beach. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Smokey Mountains
reviews.text: These guys are the best! I recommend them to everyone. There prices are great, they are all very professional and fixed my car in a timely manner. Front office staff, he was super helpful and very polite. If you need something done go to Beach Boyz you will not be disappointed!

reviews.author: Winnie B
reviews.text: I just picked up my 2014 Chevy Cruze. I brought it to the beach boyz with a broken serpentine belt (2nd one I replaced). They are professional, efficient, and problem solvers. I was not recommended to this company but I sure will be recommending people ! Great experience

reviews.author: Bradley Webb
reviews.text: I am really happy I chose this shop to bring my vehicle to! You always hope the shop you bring your car to is trustworthy, quick and fairly priced, and this one is exactly that. Stan and Nancy are great, friendly people! If I’m in the area with car trouble again or even in need of a simple oil change, I’ll be a returning customer! Thank you!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Moore
reviews.text: I can’t recommend these folks highly enough! My family and I were visiting from out of town when all my brake lights went out. I was nervous about trying to drive my children back home without brake lights, and I called at 8am on a Friday to ask if they could take a look that day. The owners, Stan and Nancy, were absolutely delightful. Stan even gave me a lift back to our house so I wouldn’t have to take an Uber or wait at the shop. They could have easily insisted upon an expensive emergency “repair,” as I’m not car savvy, but they quickly diagnosed a simple problem and fixed it at a very reasonable price. These folks are honest, personable, and knowledgeable, the kind of unicorn auto shop everyone dreams of finding.

reviews.author: Donna Schwartz
reviews.text: We were here visiting and had a problem with a heating problem in our car. The owner, Stan immediately took our car back and ran a diagnostic test on it and determined everything looked okay. He showed my husband the test result. Stan was so kind to us. I highly recommend this place for your auto service needs.

reviews.author: Chris T
reviews.text: While my family and I were on vacation, we encountered a check engine light on our vehicle. I called the shop told them my situation and they accommodated me even though they were fully booked! My family and I were able to make it home safely. Thank you again for your service. It’s good to know that there are still good hearted mechanics out there!

reviews.author: Emily Jackson
reviews.text: Back story- I was driving home from work Thursday and my car overheated and I was terrified and barely made it home. Had no idea what was wrong with my car needless to say I was freaking out. They are life savors- had my car in and out the very next day when I was so overwhelmed with what I was going to do. Will always recommend and come here from now on!

reviews.author: Dan DeFreest
reviews.text: My car died and had no power at all. I called Beach Boyz and spoke to Stan, he was friendly and concerned. I had the car towed there and within a few minutes Stan found the problem, after having motor mounts replaced at another shop a few months ago, they failed to secure the ground wire from the battery. Stan repaired the issue and I was back on the road in less than an hour. I highly recommend Beach Boyz, It's hard to find a mechanic that you can trust, I finally have!

reviews.author: Buz Carpenter
reviews.text: I had a problem with my brake lines on my 23 year old car. Took it to several places for an estimate of repairs and some wouldn't even look at it while others quoted a price so high that I knew that they really didn't want to work on my car. I went to Beach Boyz on the recommendation of a friend and I'm very happy that I did. As soon as I explained my problem, the reply was 'Sure, no problem!" Gave me a quote of a repair job if possible and would call if there was a snag. Ended up replacing the rear two brake lines, which were custom made on the site and had it ready in less than a day. I was given a quote, but was pleasantly surprised when I went to pay and found that it didn't take as long as estimated and I was charged for work actually done, not just the estimated price as other places do. I have begun to spread the word with my friends and relatives about the excellent service and treatment of customers Beach Boyz has. I recommend this business highly.

reviews.author: Natalie Demarco
reviews.text: Stan and the guys at Beach Boyz are the only people I will take my cars to. Honest, friendly, courteous and the best mechanics I've ever seen down here and I've been here for 20 years.

reviews.author: WBIII DISPATCH
reviews.text: Stan and his wife were amazing. He took in my F150 for an alignment and front tire change. He took his time went over the entire truck to make sure it was done the right way (as I have been mislead in the past with other repair shops.) This family run shop is the real deal. Thanks again guys I will be back . Webb

reviews.author: Dyl Russell
reviews.text: Best service around! These guys care about there customer’s & make sure you know what’s going on with your car! Thanks again !

reviews.author: Sarah Dennis
reviews.text: Amazing is all I can say. Our jeep started running hot Friday morning and we had our vehicle back the same day with the issue resolved/ parts replaced. Beyond stressed being on vaca and vehicle not operable. The entire staff made the entire process so much better. Phenomenal customer service. I don’t ever write reviews but I was very impressed with the service we received. Thank you again beach boyz!

reviews.author: Mary Ann Treutle
reviews.text: I was concerned about an unfamiliar ticking sound in my engine, And I stopped by the repair shop without an appointment. The repair man/owner? Came out and listened to the sound and assured me that it was not a major problem. He did not charge me for this consultation, and I want to acknowledge the generosity of this company!!

reviews.author: Aaron Tom
reviews.text: We were on vacation when the A/C unit in my wife's car stopped working, with only one day left in our trip. Needless to say my wife was frantic! These guys got us in that same day, figured out the issue (the compressor had gone out), and had a new one installed by the end of the day. The price was very reasonable considering their beachside, touristy location, and they didn't keep trying to tack on other unnecessary fixes just to run up the bill. Their work is also guaranteed (they operate through the NAPA network) which is an added bonus. I hate most mechanic shops because I always feel like they try to nickel and dime you, especially when they know you're relying on them to make it home safely, but I didn't get that feeling at all here, and I wouldn't hesitate to use these guys again should we run into troubles during future vacations here. God forbid.

reviews.author: Carrie Mitchell
reviews.text: Two engine check codes, one resolved in a snap (think gas cap, duh!) and the other did not come back on and may have been related to the first code. No charge! Mr. Mechanic said But if check engine does come on or you need anything else, we'll take care of you! He was friendly as can be. Meanwhile some other shop said to replace my engine control motor, so Beach Boyz saved me over $400.

reviews.author: Amy Scism
reviews.text: Was very pleased with the service I received at Beach Boyz. Being from out of town I was worried about where I should go for my car repair. Was in and out in one day which was wonderful since it was my AC that was not working. Randy couldn’t have been more helpful or polite. Even giving me tips on some good places to eat, which is always a good thing. Would definitely recommend using Beach Boyz for your car service.

reviews.author: Brandy Epler
reviews.text: I called in the morning and they were able to get me in the same day. The cost was almost 50% less than I would have paid at the dealership. They even went above and beyond by putting my new windshield wiper on that I purchased at the store. They truly care about their customers, I will be back!

reviews.author: Dr. Lee
reviews.text: Stan, his wife and the entire staff are always very professional and pleasant. They keep me informed, let me know what the estimated cost may be and explain in detail what the repairs entailed.

reviews.author: bobby karegianes
reviews.text: Out of town from Florida. Found Stan and Nancy on Google reviews. Best of the Best. Professional,Honest, And know their stuff. Went out pf their way to take care of me.Great experience and piece of mind traveling in an older vehicle with family, Dog and bird. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Drema
reviews.text: Had the greatest experience with Beach Boyz getting us a new tire in record time. Will DEFINITELY use them again if needed. Very friendly and efficient.

reviews.author: Elena Pelcher
reviews.text: Stan was amazing - he went above and beyond. Our truck started making noise the day before we were leaving to drive back to Rochester (13 hr drive). No one was interested in helping us - we called the shop and he was amazing - worked on the truck that day drove us home snd came back to pick us up. I can’t thank him enough - what a great business with that personal touch. Thank you Stan.

reviews.author: james Wheeler
reviews.text: Ac went out on vacation and front end having issues. Was getting outrageous estimates around town and no one could get me in. Beach boys went above and beyond. They squeezed my in and took care of me. And did it at a great price. Thanks for all the help Beach boys is the best.

reviews.author: M barnett
reviews.text: Have used this repair shop since moved here 7 years ago. They do exceptional work for reasonable price. I have never had an issue with them over any work done and I have used them numerous times for personal and family autos. I always recommend them to anyone needing their services.They are also prompt and courteous.

reviews.author: Dillon Smith
reviews.text: Just moved to the area and was looking for a good mechanic. Needed an oil change and had a cylinder 1 and 2 misfire. Dropped it off in the morning and picked my car up later that afternoon. Will not go to another mechanic, these guys are the best!

reviews.author: La Vita Moore
reviews.text: Everyone at Beach Boyz Repair is professional. This Auto Repair Shop is Number One! They’re Honest with a high sense of Integrity. They’ll never ‘gouge’ you. I’m 67 years old and this is one of the finest shops I’ve ever dealt with. Highly recommendable.

reviews.author: Debbie Melloni
reviews.text: We had dropped off our children at the karate school next door and needed a charge on our air conditioner for a trip we were getting ready to take. They were able to squeeze us in and quickly took care of the charge. I am impressed by not only their polite and courteous staff, but by how reasonable their prices are.

reviews.author: Mickey Bunts
reviews.text: New owners from Jersey just bought it. Tried to get a appointment for my van and they told me to call back at noon. I actually was into area and stopped in. They said they couldn’t do it that day but took my number and promised to call me. Never called. Took it to Glenn’s Bay Automotive. They did a great job!

reviews.author: Shannon Stamos
reviews.text: Can I give more than 5 stars? These guys are awesome. I always thought that taking my car to the dealership for maintenance was somehow better. After getting bamboozled by Honda yet again, I called Beach Boyz for a quote on a repair Honda decided to tack on while they were in the middle of doing my brakes. Turns out the extra repair was completely unnecessary. Since then I've taken my Acura to Randy and his team for everything. Alternator, battery, tire leaks, sunroof malfunctions, oil changes, timing belt- always solid work at a reasonable price and I've never left feeling like I've been sold something I don't need. For a woman who knows just enough about cars to know that she doesn't know a lot- this is huge.

reviews.author: doug jorgensen
reviews.text: New to town and got the name beach boyz from some neighbors . Called in with what might be a transmission coolant leak, this turned out to be a bad head gasket. They gave me a competitive price. The next day my pickup was ready, when I got there to pick it up I was meet at the door with a smile. While they were working on the head gasket they located a main lead off of the water pump that was leaking badly. The replaced the part for part cost only . It was nice to find this kind of shop that cares about customers first . By the way they showed me were the problem was on both parts.

reviews.author: Angela Webb
reviews.text: Randy is awesome! Very professional and helpful. He's very honest and don't try to take advantage of your wallet with their services. Very knowledgeable and goes above and beyond to make sure you get your situation straightened out!

reviews.author: Kevin
reviews.text: Very happy with Beach Boyz Auto's professional repairs. Hard-pressed to find a better or more honest mechanic. Randy did a great job at a very fair price. I'd give six stars if I could!

reviews.author: Thomas Drewek
reviews.text: I expected to have my alternator changed. All it was a build-up on the battery connector and the connector was corroded and broke. These people at this place are honest and awesome. Such a good group including the receptionist on the phone. THANK YOU. Will be back.

reviews.author: Steve Ferguson
reviews.text: I had beach boys install a new wheel hub. Fair price some other places priced at more a few less. Offered to drive me to work and pick me up. Friendly service and they will show you the parts they replaced.

reviews.author: Pattie Crocker
reviews.text: On vacation my alternator and radiator tore up. I chose Beach Boys Auto to repair it. They did a awesome job at a great price. I can't thank them enough for their hard work in such a short amount of time. Thank you so much.

reviews.author: Ray Jay
reviews.text: Amazing experience at Beach Boyz! They got my car done in a pinch with great customer service and a fantastic value. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Mesha Whitman
reviews.text: STAN IS THE MAN!!! We traveled all the way from Ohio, and on the way had an accident. While down here in Myrtle Beach we called Beach Boyz and Stan got us in right away. Evan did an amazing repair job! These guys are an answered prayer! Now we can get home safely without worry. Thanks a million!

reviews.author: Tanya Soroka
reviews.text: Beach Boyz are Great to work with! Very helpful and explained everything that was going on. Even called me to ask for permission before performing extra services. I really appreciate them! Super friendly! I will recommend and use again if needed. Thank you!

reviews.author: Marjorie LaReau
reviews.text: When you walk in theres no fan Fair and circumstance. Its a repair shop. Period. I liked the direct honest answers, and my repairs were reasonably priced. There was no pressure to upsell anything. Just honest feedback regarding your vehicle. The place was busy with locals, another good sign, as one could tell mist were repeat customers. Standard oil change with fluid top offs a flat $26!!

reviews.author: LadyoftheFallen
reviews.text: Stan & crew @ beach boyz auto repair are a god send, stranded & broken down they had my truck repaired n squared away in less then 24hours. Customer service & work were both outstanding. I would recommend this shop to anyone in need of auto work. Thank you for everything!!

reviews.author: Matthew Jernigan
reviews.text: In from out of town and ran over a big ol nail. Called Beach Boyz up and they told me to bring it on by. Plugged the hole and I was back on the road quick! Everyone was friendly and professional. Best vibe I've ever experienced at a shop. Can't recommend enough - wish they were in my town!

reviews.author: Cynthia Bedenbaugh
reviews.text: Truck would not start. Called Beach Boyz, got the truck to them at 11:30 a.m. and they replaced the starter and changed the oil. I had the truck back at 3:30 p.m. Nice guys that do good work at a reasonable price.

reviews.author: Matthew Gould
reviews.text: I brought my wife's dodge caravan in because we kept having issues after bringing it to where we purchased it Auto world of conway.They told us it was bad brakes we spent money on it still bad issue brought to Stan at beach boys and he determined it was her transmission. He didnt even charge for his time. STAN WAS AMAZING HONEST AND HELPED THROUGHOUT THESE STRESSFUL TIMES. THANKS STAN

reviews.author: Bmo Gaming
reviews.text: They were really helpful in helping me find out what was wrong with my car. Gave me great pricing and the work was great my car needed a water pump and they did it without taking a lot of time. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Fred Wright
reviews.text: So glad I found these guys..very pleasant to deal with, with none of the BS I’ve dealt with at others auto repair shops. Thankfully, this was only a tire repair, but with the attitude of the employees, and there efforts to see to it the customer was happy, I wouldn’t hesitate returning here. Appreciated the service gentlemen!!

reviews.author: Joseph Flora
reviews.text: Always a pleasure to deal with.had my truck towed to beach boyz.they had plenty of appointments before me.but somehow got my truck back on the road next day.these guys are fantastic.and price was very fair.

reviews.author: Austin Sleasman
reviews.text: Great mechanic. Resolved all my car problems at reasonable price for the location and timing! Fast and friendly! Very reliable go to!!! Would recommend to anyone in a pinch! Thanks a million!

reviews.author: mike potter
reviews.text: I was stranded in Myrtle Beach (from Canada) with a strange knocking sound coming from my front end; Beach Boyz recognized my predicament and 'squeezed' me into their already packed schedule, and had me up & running in a day and a half; very professional and FRIENDLY service.... I guess that's why they have awards up on their walls! I would highly recommend Beach Boyz to everyone!

reviews.author: Jimmy Aiken
reviews.text: i took my nissan truck to beach boyz for a brake job. i told the service manager 3 times that my rotors were in bad shape and needed turning or replacing. the service manager called me to say the repair would be $312. i assumed that would take care of the rotors also. i called 9 hrs later and they said that it was ready. i picked it up and all they had done for $312 is put on new brake pads. won't go back and will advise everyone to steer away. halls treated customers right. beach boyz should have observed.

reviews.author: Kevin Calandra
reviews.text: These guys are fantastic. Whether your job is big or small they treat you with the same courtesy and professionalism. They will always try to fit you in if they can and their pricing is very reasonable and the best I have seen in the area. Great shop great people

reviews.author: Raydio
reviews.text: Drove down on vacation and started hearing a grinding noise. They got me in first thing on a Monday morning and got it taken care of. Fast, honest, and reliable. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: bones jaeger
reviews.text: Beach Boys auto repair is great, 5 stars. Not only do they do the work in a timely professional manner, most importantly they are trust worthy good people. I totally recommend Beach Boys auto shop in Surfside Bch. SC. MJ

reviews.author: Mark Knight
reviews.text: Randy was great !! He handled my 1996 Camaro Z28 fuel pump assembly replacement perfectly!! I highly recommend Beach Boyz Auto Repair for all your auto repair needs!!

reviews.author: Jack Ebright

reviews.author: Kevin Yates
reviews.text: They have always been the best mechanics on the strand! Most courteous and accommodating when we needed help. I always recommend them to everyone that needs any work done on their car. Thank you! Kevin

reviews.author: Jonathan McCormick
reviews.text: I recommend Beach Boyz Auto Repair to anyone. They did a great job and had me back on the road and working in no time. Thank you Stan and crew. Outstanding service!

reviews.text: Beach Boyz have helped me out on several occasions. They are friendly yet professional all the time. With each dilemma I bring them it is solved right away in a way I can handle. Thank you Beach Boyz . They also have a great sense of humor.

reviews.text: I was in a bind with a problem with my daughter's car and needed it fixed before I left her at college. Stan was able to squeeze me in last minute and took care of my problem and was more than reasonably priced. A real life saver. Thanks Stan.
